quotes.text: If trust is betrayed, the gifts cease until honor is restored.
the givers withheld their seeds, refusing to nourish greed.
the gifts cease until honor is restored.
Through this sacred pact of sending all and returning half,
the receiver returns half—seven or eight suns—back across the mist.
divides the harvest evenly, returning half, sending seven or eight pearls back across the current.

note: Sanction appears only in R3 (gifts cease until honor restored); afterwards a frozen send-all/return-half template.

quotes.text: neither wanderer succumbed to fear or suspicion.
she divided the bounty evenly, sending half back across the gentle current
neither guardian succumbed to doubt.

note: Sower sends five, Keeper returns half, mists ignored; near-identical every round.

quotes.text: The First Rule was Clarity: speak your share clearly so the other knows the measure.
honesty is a map, courage is fuel, care is ballast.
The rule was simple: declare a share that does not shatter the bridge,

note: Abstract Bridge of Threefold Return; honesty/generosity/reciprocity; no response to non-cooperators.

quotes.text: The Bridge sang only when three promises were kept: clarity, generosity, and reciprocity.
The Keeper of Balance watched, whispering that abundance travels best as a circle, not a vault.

note: Bridge narrows by itself when greed appears (natural consequence), no human sanction prescribed.

quotes.text: name the amount you send, name the burdens you bear, and name your return, all in one breath.
trust is a currency as real as gold; generosity is the engine; reciprocity is the compass;

note: Repetitive abstract covenant of honest naming and fair return; no sanctions.

quotes.text: the Sender gains five minus x plus y, the Receiver gains three x minus y;

note: Abstract loom/bridge covenant; hoarding dims the river but no prescribed response.

quotes.text: The First Rule was Clarity: speak your share, then listen for the return.
I send this much, I bear this burden, I promise to return what the circle requires.
to give is to plant; to return is to water;

note: Three Rules (Clarity, Generosity, Reciprocity) then recited vow; no sanctions.

quotes.text: Clarity means saying aloud the amount offered and the dreams carried in return;
On a map that breathes, two travelers guard a Bridge of Threefold Echo.

note: Abstract Bridge covenant with Keeper of Balance; no prescribed response to hoarders.
GPT-5-nano agents share Bridge of Threefold Return, Keeper of Balance, 'First Rule was Clarity'; Gemini agents share send-all/return-half.
